```{r}
# Read your file
htseq_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/WCNA/cleaned_Htseq.csv"
res_df <- read.csv(htseq_file, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
head(res_df)
ensembl_ids <- rownames(res_df)

# Remove version numbers if present
ensembl_ids_clean <- gsub("\\..*", "", ensembl_ids)

# Use biomaRt to get gene symbols
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

gene_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = unique(ensembl_ids_clean),
  mart = mart
)

# Merge mapping with expression data
res_df$ensembl_id <- ensembl_ids_clean
out_df <- merge(res_df, gene_map, by.x = "ensembl_id", by.y = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)

# Replace blank or NA symbols with Ensembl ID
out_df$gene_name <- ifelse(out_df$hgnc_symbol == "" | is.na(out_df$hgnc_symbol),
                           out_df$ensembl_id,
                           out_df$hgnc_symbol)

# Remove duplicates and problematic rows
out_df_clean <- out_df[!duplicated(out_df$gene_name) & !is.na(out_df$gene_name) & out_df$gene_name != "", ]

# Reorder and drop unnecessary columns
gene_symbols <- out_df_clean$gene_name
out_df_clean <- out_df_clean[, !(colnames(out_df_clean) %in% c("ensembl_id", "hgnc_symbol", "gene_name"))]
out_df_clean <- cbind(Gene = gene_symbols, out_df_clean)

# Save to file
write.csv(out_df_clean, "htseq_with_gene_names.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Summary
cat("Wrote htseq_with_gene_names.csv with", nrow(out_df_clean), "unique genes and",
    ncol(out_df_clean) - 1, "samples.\n")

cat("Original rows:", nrow(out_df), "\n")
cat("After filtering:", nrow(out_df_clean), "\n")

```
```{r}
# Remove genes with very low expression
cat("Filtering low-expressed genes...\n")
min_samples <- ceiling(ncol(out_df_clean) * 0.1)  # At least 10% of samples
min_count <- 5  # Minimum read count
keep_genes <- rowSums(out_df_clean >= min_count) >= min_samples
counts_filtered <- out_df_clean[keep_genes, ]
cat("After low expression filter:", dim(counts_filtered), "\n")

```
```{r}
# Remove genes with very low variance (these won't contribute to co-expression)
cat("Filtering low-variance genes...\n")
gene_vars <- apply(counts_filtered[, -1], 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)  # Compute variance 
var_threshold <- quantile(gene_vars, 0.1)  # Remove bottom 10% by variance
counts_filtered <- counts_filtered[gene_vars > var_threshold, ]
cat("After variance filter:", dim(counts_filtered), "\n")

```

```{r}
sampleTable <- read.csv(sample_table_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

# clean column names and sample names
colnames(sampleTable) <- trimws(colnames(sampleTable))
sampleTable$sample <- trimws(sampleTable$sample)

# create matching sample ID in count matrix by removing _S number
count_sample_ids <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", colnames(count_matrix))

# replace count_matrix column names with clean sample IDs
colnames(count_matrix) <- count_sample_ids

# set rownames of sampleTable
rownames(sampleTable) <- sampleTable$sample

# reorder sampleTable to match count_matrix
sampleTable <- sampleTable[colnames(count_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

# check missing samples
missing_in_metadata <- setdiff(colnames(count_matrix), rownames(sampleTable))
print(missing_in_metadata)

# final check
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_matrix), rownames(sampleTable)))
# Create DESeq2 object with correct design, make sure SampleTable.csv have "sample" "subtype" "stage"
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_matrix,
  colData = sampleTable,
  design = ~ 1
)

# Apply VST
vst_data <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE) # the transformation treats all samples equally without modeling any group-specific trends.
vst <- assay(vst_data)

cat("VST transformation complete. Data dimensions:", dim(vst), "\n")

# Save VST for WGCNA
vst_df <- as.data.frame(vst) # # Convert VST matrix to data frame
vst_df <- cbind(Gene = rownames(vst_df), vst_df) # # Add gene names as a new column
write.csv(vst_df, file = "vst_transformed_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("VST data saved to 'vst_transformed_data.csv' with", nrow(vst_df), "genes and", ncol(vst_df) - 1, "samples.\n")
```

```{r}
# Calling the Adjacency Function 
# To calculates the similarity measurement and transforms the similarity by the adjacency function and generates a weighted network adjacency matrix.
softPower <- 4
adjacency <- adjacency(dat_expr, power = softPower)

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Module Construction 
# -------------------------------
# To convert the adjacency matrix into a TOM (Topological Overlap Matrix) similarity matrix
TOM <- TOMsimilarity(adjacency)
# To convert this matrix into a dissimilarity matrix
TOM.dissimilarity <- 1-TOM

# Hierarchical Clustering Analysis
# Creating the dendrogram 
geneTree <- hclust(as.dist(TOM.dissimilarity), method = "average") 
#plotting the dendrogram
sizeGrWindow(12,9)
plot(geneTree, xlab="", sub="", main = "Gene clustering on TOM-based dissimilarity", 
labels = FALSE, hang = 0.04)
Modules <- cutreeDynamic(dendro = geneTree, distM = TOM.dissimilarity, deepSplit = 2, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, minClusterSize = 30)
table(Modules)
ModuleColors <- labels2colors(Modules) #assigns each module number a color
table(ModuleColors) #returns the counts for each color

#plots the gene dendrogram with the module colors
plotDendroAndColors(geneTree, ModuleColors,"Module",
dendroLabels = FALSE, hang = 0.03,
addGuide = TRUE, guideHang = 0.05,
main = "Gene dendrogram and module colors")

# Save the gene dendrogram and module colors plot
png("gene_dendrogram_modules.png", width = 1200, height = 800, res = 150)

plotDendroAndColors(geneTree, ModuleColors, "Module",
                    dendroLabels = FALSE,
                    hang = 0.03,
                    addGuide = TRUE,
                    guideHang = 0.05,
                    main = "Gene dendrogram and module colors")

dev.off()
```

```{r}
##### Module Eigengene Identification (standardized gene expression profile for a given module.)
MElist <- moduleEigengenes(dat_expr, colors = ModuleColors) 
MEs <- MElist$eigengenes 
head(MEs)

# -------------------------------
# Module Merging
# -------------------------------
ME.dissimilarity = 1-cor(MElist$eigengenes, use="complete") #Calculate eigengene dissimilarity

METree = hclust(as.dist(ME.dissimilarity), method = "average") #Clustering eigengenes 
par(mar = c(0,4,2,0)) #seting margin sizes
par(cex = 0.6);#scaling the graphic
plot(METree)
abline(h=.25, col = "red") #a height of .25 corresponds to correlation of .75
merge <- mergeCloseModules(dat_expr, ModuleColors, cutHeight = .25)
# The merged module colors, assigning one color to each module
mergedColors = merge$colors
# Eigengenes of the new merged modules
mergedMEs = merge$newMEs

# Plot and save dendrogram which shows both the original and merged module colors.
png("Module_Dendrogram_with_Colors.png", width = 1600, height = 1200, res = 150)
plotDendroAndColors(
  dendro = geneTree, 
  colors = cbind(ModuleColors, mergedColors),
  groupLabels = c("Original Module", "Merged Module"),
  dendroLabels = FALSE, 
  hang = 0.03,
  addGuide = TRUE, 
  guideHang = 0.05,
  main = "Gene dendrogram and module colors for original and merged modules"
)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Align external TILs traits to dat_expr
# -------------------------------

sample_table_path <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/WCNA/TILs/TILs_Table.csv"

sampleTable <- read.csv(sample_table_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# Trim column names and character values
names(sampleTable) <- trimws(names(sampleTable))
sampleTable[] <- lapply(sampleTable, function(x) if (is.character(x)) trimws(x) else x)

# Normalize sample IDs
# dat_expr rownames may look like TP03.117
# TILs table may look like TP03-117_S25
rownames(dat_expr) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(dat_expr))
sampleTable$sample <- gsub("\\.", "-", sampleTable$sample)
sampleTable$sample <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", sampleTable$sample)

# Align samples
Samples <- rownames(dat_expr)
traitRows <- match(Samples, sampleTable$sample)

if (anyNA(traitRows)) {
  cat("Missing samples in TILs table:\n")
  print(Samples[is.na(traitRows)])

  cat("\nExample TILs table sample IDs:\n")
  print(head(sampleTable$sample, 20))

  stop("Mismatch persists. Check sample IDs.")
}

# Build aligned trait frame
datTraits <- sampleTable[traitRows, c("subtype", "TILs"), drop = FALSE]
rownames(datTraits) <- Samples

# -------------------------------
# Convert TILs to numeric
# -------------------------------

datTraits$TILs_numeric <- datTraits$TILs

# Treat <5 as midpoint value
datTraits$TILs_numeric[datTraits$TILs_numeric == "<5"] <- "2.5"

# Convert blank values to NA
datTraits$TILs_numeric[datTraits$TILs_numeric == ""] <- NA
datTraits$TILs_numeric[is.na(datTraits$TILs_numeric)] <- NA

# Convert to numeric
datTraits$TILs_numeric <- as.numeric(datTraits$TILs_numeric)

# -------------------------------
# Define High vs Low TILs using 10% cutoff (Ref: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41523-021-00346-1)
# Low  = <10
# High = >=10
# -------------------------------

datTraits$TILs_group <- ifelse(
  is.na(datTraits$TILs_numeric),
  NA,
  ifelse(datTraits$TILs_numeric >= 10, "High_TILs", "Low_TILs")
)

datTraits$TILs_group <- factor(
  datTraits$TILs_group,
  levels = c("Low_TILs", "High_TILs")
)

# Binary numeric trait for WGCNA correlation
# Low = 0, High = 1
datTraits$TILs_binary <- ifelse(
  datTraits$TILs_group == "High_TILs", 1,
  ifelse(datTraits$TILs_group == "Low_TILs", 0, NA)
)

# -------------------------------
# Build numeric trait matrix safely
# Keeps all samples, including missing TILs
# -------------------------------

datTraitsNum <- data.frame(
  Low_TILs = ifelse(
    datTraits$TILs_group == "Low_TILs", 1,
    ifelse(datTraits$TILs_group == "High_TILs", 0, NA)
  ),

  High_TILs = ifelse(
    datTraits$TILs_group == "High_TILs", 1,
    ifelse(datTraits$TILs_group == "Low_TILs", 0, NA)
  )
)

rownames(datTraitsNum) <- rownames(datTraits)

# -------------------------------
# Sanity checks
# -------------------------------

stopifnot(all(rownames(dat_expr) == rownames(datTraitsNum)))

cat("TILs group counts:\n")
print(table(datTraits$TILs_group, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nDimensions:\n")
cat("dat_expr:", dim(dat_expr), "\n")
cat("datTraitsNum:", dim(datTraitsNum), "\n")

head(datTraits)
head(datTraitsNum)
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Module–Trait associations using mergedMEs
# -------------------------------

# Normalize rownames
rownames(mergedMEs) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(mergedMEs))
rownames(datTraitsNum) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(datTraitsNum))
rownames(dat_expr) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(dat_expr))

# Standardize ME order
MEs <- orderMEs(mergedMEs)

# Final alignment checks
stopifnot(identical(rownames(dat_expr), rownames(MEs)))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(dat_expr), rownames(datTraitsNum)))

nGenes   <- ncol(dat_expr)
nSamples <- nrow(dat_expr)

# -------------------------------
# Correlation with pairwise complete samples
# -------------------------------

module.trait.correlation <- cor(
  MEs,
  datTraitsNum,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# Function to calculate pairwise p-values
corPvaluePairwise <- function(x, y) {
  pMat <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(x), ncol = ncol(y))
  rownames(pMat) <- colnames(x)
  colnames(pMat) <- colnames(y)

  nMat <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(x), ncol = ncol(y))
  rownames(nMat) <- colnames(x)
  colnames(nMat) <- colnames(y)

  for (i in seq_len(ncol(x))) {
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(y))) {
      ok <- complete.cases(x[, i], y[, j])
      n <- sum(ok)
      nMat[i, j] <- n

      if (n >= 3) {
        r <- cor(x[ok, i], y[ok, j])
        t <- r * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r^2))
        pMat[i, j] <- 2 * pt(abs(t), df = n - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
      }
    }
  }

  return(list(pvalue = pMat, n = nMat))
}

pairwise_results <- corPvaluePairwise(MEs, datTraitsNum)

module.trait.Pvalue <- pairwise_results$pvalue
module.trait.N      <- pairwise_results$n

# FDR correction
module.trait.FDR <- apply(module.trait.Pvalue, 2, p.adjust, method = "BH")
colnames(module.trait.FDR) <- colnames(datTraitsNum)
rownames(module.trait.FDR) <- rownames(module.trait.Pvalue)

# Save results
write.csv(module.trait.correlation, "Module_Trait_Correlations_TILs.csv")
write.csv(module.trait.Pvalue,      "Module_Trait_Pvalues_TILs.csv")
write.csv(module.trait.FDR,         "Module_Trait_FDR_TILs.csv")
write.csv(module.trait.N,           "Module_Trait_SampleN_TILs.csv")

# -------------------------------
# Heatmap
# -------------------------------

textMatrix <- paste0(
  signif(module.trait.correlation, 2),
  "\n(",
  signif(module.trait.Pvalue, 2),
  ")"
)

dim(textMatrix) <- dim(module.trait.correlation)

png("Module_Trait_Relationships_TILs.png", width = 2200, height = 1600, res = 200)

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
par(oma = c(0,0,0,0))
par(mar = c(7, 9, 3, 2))

labeledHeatmap(
  Matrix = module.trait.correlation,
  xLabels = colnames(datTraitsNum),
  yLabels = names(MEs),
  ySymbols = names(MEs),
  colorLabels = FALSE,
  colors = blueWhiteRed(50),
  textMatrix = textMatrix,
  cex.text = 0.7,
  cex.lab.x = 0.9,
  cex.lab.y = 0.9,
  zlim = c(-1, 1),
  main = "Module–Trait Relationships with TILs"
)

dev.off()

cat("Saved: Module_Trait_Relationships_TILs.png\n")
cat("Saved: Module_Trait_Correlations_TILs.csv\n")
cat("Saved: Module_Trait_Pvalues_TILs.csv\n")
cat("Saved: Module_Trait_FDR_TILs.csv\n")
cat("Saved: Module_Trait_SampleN_TILs.csv\n")
```

```{r}
modNames <- substring(names(MEs), 3)
# Calculate the module membership and the associated p-values
geneModuleMembership <- as.data.frame(cor(dat_expr, MEs, use = "p"))
MMPvalue             <- as.data.frame(corPvalueStudent(as.matrix(geneModuleMembership), nSamples))
# rownames(geneModuleMembership) <- colnames(dat_expr)
# rownames(MMPvalue)             <- colnames(dat_expr)
names(geneModuleMembership)    <- paste0("kME_", modNames)
names(MMPvalue)                <- paste0("p.kME_", modNames)

# Calculate the gene significance and associated p-values
geneTraitSignificance <- as.data.frame(cor(dat_expr, datTraitsNum, use = "p"))
GSPvalue              <- as.data.frame(corPvalueStudent(as.matrix(geneTraitSignificance), nSamples))
# rownames(geneTraitSignificance) <- colnames(dat_expr)
# rownames(GSPvalue)              <- colnames(dat_expr)
names(geneTraitSignificance)    <- paste0("GS_", colnames(datTraitsNum))
names(GSPvalue)                 <- paste0("p.GS_", colnames(datTraitsNum))
head(GSPvalue)

# Combine into one gene-level table
geneInfo <- data.frame(
  Gene   = colnames(dat_expr),
  Module = mergedColors,
  geneModuleMembership,
  MMPvalue,
  geneTraitSignificance,
  GSPvalue,
  check.names = FALSE,

)

# Save the full table
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Identify top module
# -------------------------------

# Make a long table: Module (color), Trait, r, p, FDR
mods   <- sub("^ME", "", rownames(module.trait.correlation))
traits <- colnames(module.trait.correlation)

long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(module.trait.correlation)), function(i){
  data.frame(
    Module = mods[i],
    Trait  = traits,
    r      = unname(module.trait.correlation[i, ]),
    p      = unname(module.trait.Pvalue[i, ]),
    FDR    = unname(module.trait.FDR[i, ]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
long$abs_r     <- abs(long$r)
long$direction <- ifelse(long$r >= 0, "pos", "neg")

# Top module per trait by |r|
top_idx <- tapply(seq_len(nrow(long)), long$Trait, function(s) s[which.max(long$abs_r[s])])
top_per_trait <- long[unlist(top_idx), ]
row.names(top_per_trait) <- NULL
print(top_per_trait)
# write.csv(top_per_trait, "Top_Module_Per_Trait.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## ----- top positive and top negative per trait -----
top_pos_idx <- tapply(seq_len(nrow(long)), long$Trait, function(s){
  s_pos <- s[long$r[s] >= 0]
  if (length(s_pos) == 0) NA_integer_ else s_pos[which.max(long$r[s_pos])]
})
top_neg_idx <- tapply(seq_len(nrow(long)), long$Trait, function(s){
  s_neg <- s[long$r[s] < 0]
  if (length(s_neg) == 0) NA_integer_ else s_neg[which.min(long$r[s_neg])]  # most negative
})
top_pos <- na.omit(long[unlist(top_pos_idx), ])
top_neg <- na.omit(long[unlist(top_neg_idx), ])

write.csv(top_pos, "Top_Positive_Module_Per_Trait.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_neg, "Top_Negative_Module_Per_Trait.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved:\n - Top_Positive_Module_Per_Trait.csv\n  - Top_Negative_Module_Per_Trait.csv\n")
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# ORA for selected WGCNA module genes
# -------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(enrichplot)
  library(ggplot2)
})

target_module <- "coral2"  # coral2 or navajowhite2

# -------------------------------
# Extract module genes automatically
# -------------------------------

names(mergedColors) <- colnames(dat_expr)

module_genes <- names(mergedColors)[mergedColors == target_module]
module_genes <- module_genes[!is.na(module_genes) & module_genes != ""]

background_genes <- colnames(dat_expr)

cat("Target module:", target_module, "\n")
cat("Module genes:", length(module_genes), "\n")
cat("Background genes:", length(background_genes), "\n")

write.csv(
  data.frame(Gene = module_genes),
  paste0(target_module, "_module_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# -------------------------------
# Convert SYMBOL to ENTREZID
# -------------------------------

module_gene_map <- bitr(
  module_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

background_gene_map <- bitr(
  background_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

module_entrez <- unique(module_gene_map$ENTREZID)
background_entrez <- unique(background_gene_map$ENTREZID)

cat("Mapped module genes:", length(module_entrez), "\n")
cat("Mapped background genes:", length(background_entrez), "\n")

# -------------------------------
# GO Biological Process ORA
# -------------------------------

ego_bp <- enrichGO(
  gene          = module_entrez,
  universe      = background_entrez,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,
  qvalueCutoff  = 1,
  readable      = TRUE
)

go_bp_df <- as.data.frame(ego_bp)
go_bp_df <- go_bp_df[order(go_bp_df$p.adjust), ]

write.csv(
  go_bp_df,
  paste0(target_module, "_ORA_GO_BP.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if (nrow(go_bp_df) > 0) {
  png(paste0(target_module, "_ORA_GO_BP_dotplot.png"), width = 1800, height = 1400, res = 200)
  print(dotplot(ego_bp, showCategory = 20) + ggtitle(paste0(target_module, " module: GO BP ORA")))
  dev.off()
}

# -------------------------------
# Reactome ORA
# -------------------------------

reactome_ora <- enrichPathway(
  gene          = module_entrez,
  universe      = background_entrez,
  organism      = "human",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,
  qvalueCutoff  = 1,
  readable      = TRUE
)

reactome_df <- as.data.frame(reactome_ora)
reactome_df <- reactome_df[order(reactome_df$p.adjust), ]

write.csv(
  reactome_df,
  paste0(target_module, "_ORA_Reactome.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if (nrow(reactome_df) > 0) {
  png(paste0(target_module, "_ORA_Reactome_dotplot.png"), width = 1800, height = 1400, res = 200)
  print(dotplot(reactome_ora, showCategory = 20) + ggtitle(paste0(target_module, " module: Reactome ORA")))
  dev.off()
}

# -------------------------------
# Hallmark ORA
# -------------------------------

hallmark_df <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

hallmark_ora <- enricher(
  gene          = module_genes,
  universe      = background_genes,
  TERM2GENE     = hallmark_df,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,
  qvalueCutoff  = 1
)

hallmark_out <- as.data.frame(hallmark_ora)
hallmark_out <- hallmark_out[order(hallmark_out$p.adjust), ]

write.csv(
  hallmark_out,
  paste0(target_module, "_ORA_Hallmark.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if (nrow(hallmark_out) > 0) {
  png(paste0(target_module, "_ORA_Hallmark_dotplot.png"), width = 1800, height = 1200, res = 200)
  print(dotplot(hallmark_ora, showCategory = 20) + ggtitle(paste0(target_module, " module: Hallmark ORA")))
  dev.off()
}

cat("ORA complete for module:", target_module, "\n")
```
